failed_run.failed_step: Publish to Google Play internal testing
failed_run.error_summary: Google Api Error: Server error - Internal error encountered. (commit after uploading phone+wear AABs together onto phone track=internal via aab_paths)

root_cause.summary: Wear OS AAB was uploaded onto the phone internal track in the same supply edit (aab_paths). Since Aug/Sep 2023 Play requires dedicated Wear form-factor tracks; combining Wear into mobile internal commonly yields opaque Internal error on edits.commit.
root_cause.fix: Split uploads: phone → internal, wear → wear:internal; default release_status=draft for draft apps; draft/Internal-error retry; clear Track-not-found guidance.

fix_summary: Fastlane internal_testing now uploads mobile and wear AABs on separate tracks (internal / wear:internal) instead of a single aab_paths commit on phone internal. PLAY_RELEASE_STATUS defaults to draft; workflow sets wear:internal + draft. docs/play-release.md documents the SNFC8 failure and Console Wear-track prerequisite.

play_console_after_local_upload.hermes_console_prerequisite: Play Console → Test and release → Advanced settings → Form factors → Wear OS → Use a dedicated release track for Wear OS → Save, then Hermes re-tags v*.
